area.label: Roof area
area.help: The area of the roof face you picked, in square metres, measured as seen from above.
area.traceLegend: Mark your roof on the photo
area.traceHelp: Tap each corner of the roof. Three corners are enough to give an area; Close shape finishes the outline. Drag a yellow square to fix a corner.
area.noImagery: The satellite photo is not available yet, so you are marking on the street map. If the roof is hard to make out, type its area instead.
area.switchToType: Can't mark it? Type the area instead
area.switchToTrace: Mark the roof on the map instead
area.mapUnsupported: The map can't be shown on this device. Type the roof's area instead.

status: {count, plural, one {# corner marked.} other {# corners marked.}}

map.label: Map of your roof. Keyboard users can type the roof's area instead.

attribution.esri: Satellite photo: <esri>Powered by Esri</esri>. Imagery sources: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics and the GIS User Community.

tooSmall.title: This roof is very small
tooSmall.body: It measures under {min} m². Check the corners you marked or the number you typed, and carry on if it is right.

tooLarge.title: This roof is very large
tooLarge.body: It measures over {max} m². Make sure you marked one roof face only, and carry on if it is right.

refused.title: This roof is too large to calculate
refused.body: The limit is {max} m². That is more than a house roof, so check the area you marked or typed and use one roof face only.

slope.help: Flat: barely tilted, like a concrete slab. Gentle: most tiled roofs, rising about 0.5 to 2.1 m for every 3 m across. Steep: rising more than 2.1 m for every 3 m.

facing.help: The direction the roof face you marked slopes down towards, where rain runs off. Your phone's compass helps if you are unsure.

shade.help: Trees, a water tank or the building next door.

usable.label: Share of the roof that can take panels
usable.help: Not all of a roof can be used: the ridge, gutters and safety gaps at the edges are kept clear.
